name: GIGA DASH BOT
description: Predictive object-aware auto-play prototype for Geometry Dash 2.2081.

controller-title.name: GIGA DASH BOT v1.1
controller-title.description: Reads native collision objects and predicts the player's path. Practice mode recommended.

auto-play.name: Enable Auto Play
auto-play.description: Automatically react to native hitbox objects. Disabled by default.

jump-lead-ms.name: Jump timing (ms)
jump-lead-ms.description: Lead time before predicted contact. Lower values jump later. Default is 95 ms.

show-debug-log.name: Debug Log
show-debug-log.description: Logs detected object type, distance, time-to-contact and action.
